{{Quote|We're having no effect on the shield.|Red Twelve|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] used the [[callsign]] of '''[[Red Twelve]]''' during the [[Galactic Civil War]] and served under [[Garven Dreis]] in [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Scarif]], he flew bravely, leading three of his wingmen on the first attack run on the Scarif Shield Gate.<ref name="Rogue One" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Stay with me!|Red Twelve|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
As part of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]], this pilot wore the customary [[Color|orange]] [[Flight suit|jumpsuit]], accompanied with a red and white striped [[flight helmet]] with yellow markings in [[Domabesh]], with the inscription on the right side of the helmet ending with "OSS", while the one on the left began with "BOO". His skin was light with blond facial hair.<ref name="Rogue One" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Red Twelve was played by [[Richard Glover]] in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.
